name: cao-ag-ui-builder
description: Emit-side AG-UI vocabulary for CLI Agent Orchestrator: the six allow-listed generative-UI components (approval_card, choice_prompt, diff_summary, progress, metric, agent_card) an agent sends with emit_ui, carried as CUSTOM `cao.generative_ui` frames. Describes CAO `main`; no released version carries this yet (#1198). Needs a local cao-server with the [agui] extra. No mcp.json.
